milestones.title: 1.0 — First release
milestones.description: Initial production release supporting 30 Ubuntu 26.04 flavors across Base, Docker, Podman, Kubernetes, and AI Inference.

milestones.title: v1.1.0 - Multi-Hypervisor & Bare-Metal Hardening
milestones.description: Direct disk streaming installer, native Unraid virtiofs auto-mount, VMware ESXi 8.x validation, and iPXE netboot.

milestones.title: v1.2.0 - Blackwell Fabric & Multi-Vendor Inference
milestones.description: NVIDIA Blackwell B200 / RTX 5090 NVLink fabric tuning, AMD Instinct MI300 ROCm 10 optimization, and automated vLLM benchmarks.

milestones.title: v1.3.0 - Aegis & Nucleus Fleet Contracts
milestones.description: Pinned producer contracts with the connected Aegis-OS stack: the aegis.p01.product-input.v1 build request and the imago.nucleus.kernel-artifact.v1 kernel artifact manifest, verified by digest and provenance before consumption. Tracks planning milestones ms-aegis and ms-nucleus.
